phases.name: opening-dot-line
phases.reference: Black field, orange dot, orange horizontal line, expansion into orange field.
phases.implementation: Exact blank opening until0.12; dot/line native geometry. Expansion is approximated by field switch at0.64.

phases.name: kinetic-motion-letters
phases.reference: MOTION letters individually jump/rotate, showreel subtitle and frame metadata.
phases.implementation: Per-letter measured Geist widths, staggered easing/rotation, second lift and subtitle; timecode and original1920x1080/60fps metadata are native text.

phases.name: every-frame-matters
phases.reference: Blue field, cream EVERY/MATTERS, yellow FRAME/EASE/PIXELS and orange underline; repeating outline typography.
phases.implementation: Independent word swaps, outline rows move laterally, letter metrics and underline animate natively.

phases.name: sphere-to-particle-word
phases.reference: Dense pink-blue rotating particle sphere and elliptical orbits regroup into CLAUDE.
phases.implementation: 2500 Fibonacci sphere particles, depth sorting/perspective, three native elliptical orbits. Every particle interpolates to uniformly sampled brand glyph mask with subtle target motion.

phases.name: shape-morphing
phases.reference: Cream dotted grid, orange circle, blue square/diamond, dark triangle, yellow irregular blob and pink star; faint contour afterimages and three orbit dots.
phases.implementation: Corresponding96point outlines interpolate/rotate with seven translucent trailing outlines. Staggered phase anchors preserve observed5.25blue diamond.

phases.name: liquid-flow-state
phases.reference: Yellow field, blue merging fluid with separate dark cores, FLOW STATE reverses color at fluid boundary.
phases.implementation: Four analytic metaball fields at256x180; union controls alpha and individual peak controls dark cores. Native glyph layer intersects fluid alpha for cream lettering inside/blue outside. Smooth scaled bitmap, no CSS filter chain or reference frames.

phases.name: nested-type-tunnel
phases.reference: Seven dense colored circular lines of typography spin/scale in opposite directions; centre LOOP/SPIN/ZOOM/WARP.
phases.implementation: Per-character measured angular placement, circumference-fit repetition, independent alternating angular speeds and radial zoom.

phases.name: numbers-that-move
phases.reference: Cream background and three cards: blue8bar keyframes, black yellow easing curve, orange frame-rate circle;57 observed at9.75.
phases.implementation: Native staggered cards,8original-style bar heights, progressive logistic path and moving dot, arc/fps57anchor then60.

phases.name: signal-noise-generative-art
phases.reference: Black field, SIGNAL/NOISE,41thin colored wave traces with broad varying peaks; horizontal glitch bars before transition.
phases.implementation: Five drifting Gaussian peaks mixed with oscillatory noise for41curves; independent warm-to-blue line colors and deterministic glitch streaks.

phases.name: compositing-all-of-it
phases.reference: Four-by-three miniature scene collection, central ALL OF IT with orange offset; grid expands/rotates away revealing centre hole.
phases.implementation: Twelve independently drawn native chapter thumbnails cached at readiness,4x3placement, central text offset, positional zoom and tile rotation. Thumbnails are static sampled native scenes, unlike source moving mini-scenes.

phases.name: claude-final-lockup
phases.reference: Multicolored CLAUDE letters descend/rotate then become cream; orange underline, typing MOTION DESIGNER, work availability pill and six decorative shapes.
phases.implementation: Per-letter staggered pose/color changes, typed editable role, pill and native rotating geometries.
